name: trm-devops-triage
description: Topic Research Mining DevOps self-healing triage, Sigil safety guard, and No-AI-Slop pre-push verification pipeline.

skills.name: TRM TinyFish Triage
skills.description: Tier-1 fast local signature diagnostics & TinyFish search for CI log failures. Invoked immediately upon a Nightly Validator or CI build failure to check for Git checkout credential blocks, submodules blocks, or Node runner deprecations.

logExtract.description: Raw terminal output or error stack trace captured from the failing CI runner.

status.description: Indicates if a deterministic match was found ('resolved') or if it needs escalation to Tier-2 ('escalated').

remediation.description: Targeted patch content, YAML configuration block, or explicit developer fix layout.

confidence.description: Confidence score of the parsed resolution blueprint.

skills.name: TRM Parallel Escalation
skills.description: Tier-2 deep agentic research loop with Basis citation tracking via Parallel Task API. Activated when Tier-1 returns low confidence, indicating complex environment collisions, dependency discrepancies, or zero-day issues.

logExtract.description: Raw failing build trace and error logs.

triageContext.description: Optional notes, unsuccessful signatures, or diagnostics passed down by the Tier-1 executor.

synthesizedRemediation.description: Synthesized resolution plan backed by external research, citations, and specific GitHub pull request guidelines.

citations.description: List of source-backed Basis citation URLs and issue references verifying the proposed fix.

skills.name: TRM Sigil Guard
skills.description: Gates destructive filesystem writes and outbound network actions by wrapping patches into a JCS-canonicalized envelope and prompting local loopback for WebAuthn biometric user consent.

candidatePatch.description: The YAML, workflow, or code patch payload proposed by Tier-1 or Tier-2.

targetFile.description: The destination file path on the local workstation disk (e.g. '.github/workflows/nightly-validator.yml').

approved.description: True if the WebAuthn physical biometric prompt (Touch ID/Windows Hello) was cleared.

signature.description: Canonical RFC 8785 lexicographically-sorted JCS signature block validating local owner approval.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 compliant UTC date-time of the biometric clearance ceremony.

skills.name: No AI Slop Quality Linter
skills.description: Pre-push and pre-commit verification skill that inspects proposed pull requests, documentation, and commits for 20+ patterns of AI slop, preambular fluff, and conversational padding. Automatically redline or sanitize AI-generated content before committing.

content.description: Raw markdown text, documentation, or code patch to analyze for AI slop patterns.

autoFix.description: If true, automatically strips identified slop phrases and returns sanitized content.

clean.description: True if no AI slop or banned preamble patterns were detected.

violationsFound.description: List of specific AI slop phrases, preambles, or forbidden buzzwords identified.

sanitizedContent.description: The cleaned text with AI slop patterns removed.
